extension.summary: Resonance: a minimal Spotify music browser and player for Kodi
Spotify-Premium-Musik in Kodi hören: Resonance-Plugin (Spotty/librespot), für ARM/LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi
extension.description: Resonance is a lightweight Spotify music browser for Kodi focused on playlists, search, albums, artists and playback. Version 1 is built and tested for LibreELEC on Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64, with experimental Android ARM binaries included. Windows, macOS and Linux x86/x64 are not supported in this release. Spotify Premium is required.

Resonance ist ein leichtgewichtiges Spotify-Musik-Add-on für Kodi mit Playlists, Suche, Alben, Künstlern und Wiedergabe. Version 1 ist für LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64 gebaut und getestet; Android-ARM-Binärdateien sind experimentell enthalten. Spotify Premium ist erforderlich.
extension.disclaimer: This product uses the SPOTIFY WEB API but is not endorsed, certified or otherwise approved in any way by Spotify. Spotify is the registered trademark of Spotify AB.
Dieses Produkt verwendet die SPOTIFY WEB API, wird jedoch in keiner Weise von Spotify unterstützt, zertifiziert oder anderweitig genehmigt. Spotify ist eine eingetragene Marke von Spotify AB.
extension.news: [B]1.2.2[/B] - Simpler Account and status: one clear row per topic, tap it for the next step. - Pairing from Account and status goes on to browser sign-in when needed. - Clear messages when playback or search needs sign-in. - Setup always starts with the Client ID, then pairing, then sign-in. - Menus, dialogs and notifications translated: English, Dutch, German, Spanish, French, Hebrew. [B]1.2.1[/B] - Guided setup asks to finish setup when not fully signed in; rerun from Settings. - Each setup step reports its result in a dialog. - Reset Resonance in Settings > Account (keeps a backup). - Pairing during setup no longer starts playback. - Stalled Spotify Connect audio restarts the receiver. - Spotify Client ID kept safely across restarts. - Fixed busy spinner after setup sign-in. [B]1.2.0[/B] - Finish setup/login navigation, fixing stuck busy spinner. - Fixed Spotify setup and Android playback authentication. - Added Spotify Connect audio (Android ARM64/ARMv7, Linux ARM64). - Use Kodi's streaming player to avoid live audio stuttering. [B]1.1.0[/B] - Added Your Spotify Library, search, playlists, write actions. - Fixed artist/track context menus and playback status rows. - Removed local Kodi Favorites; one Reauthorize needed. [B]1.0.x[/B] - Artist menus, playlist playback, browser-login refresh fix. - Version 1 release for LibreELEC/Raspberry Pi.

extension.summary: Backup and restore LibreELEC system settings and configurations
extension.description: Automatically backup and restore your LibreELEC system settings, configurations, and addons. Supports local and remote storage locations with smart backup rotation.
extension.disclaimer: This addon is not affiliated with LibreELEC or Kodi.
extension.news: v1.5.2 (2026-10-27) - Added optional Kodi video database backups using a consistent SQLite snapshot, including WAL data. - Restore detects database versions, validates integrity, and preserves an existing database of the same or newer version. v1.5.0 (2026-04-12) - FEATURE RELEASE - Added custom dashboard and backup browser windows with skin XML layouts. - New custom settings/help details for better guidance. - Added backup summary popup toggle in Notifications. - Remote storage usage now visible on dashboard. - Improved restore UX with reliable progress and less notification noise. - Detailed, colorized operation summaries added. - Improved backup detection and date parsing for all naming formats. - Hardened restore handling for file permission/path errors. - Cleaned up Remote Settings Test Connection diagnostics. - Switched all popups to custom GUI dialogs with fallback support. - Fixed Credits display and settings navigation edge cases. - Automatic mounting/unmounting of addons directory during restore.
